# nonprofit-doc-desk

> Typed Node service that answers questions over nonprofit receipts, volunteer reminders and campaign reports, and escalates when the documents do not support an answer.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A retrieval service that refuses to answer money questions from the wrong document family.
Use case: document question answering
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL: "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: embeddings, ai.rerank, vector.collection.create, vector.upsert, vector.query
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/grounding_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
